# Gujarat Bio Organics Pvt. Ltd.
> Manufacturer of organic fertilizers, biostimulants (humic acid, seaweed extract, amino acids), biofertilisers and specialty fertilizers (micronutrients, water-soluble special grades, slow-release, custom blends, zyme granules) in Shihor, Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India, with in-house R&D. Supplies under its Immunity brand, under buyers' private labels, and in bulk. Exports worldwide.

## Key facts
- About this site: b2b.gujaratbio.com is the open, public B2B website of Gujarat Bio Organics. No login or dealer approval is needed to browse it: buyers request quotes and free samples directly. It is not a login-restricted dealer portal and has no shopping cart; orders start from a quote request or WhatsApp.
- Legal name: Gujarat Bio Organics Private Limited. CIN U24123GJ2009PTC058701. GSTIN 24AADCG6029R1Z7. Incorporated 25 Nov 2009.
- Factory: Plot No. 321, GIDC 2, Ghanghali Road, Shihor, Bhavnagar, Gujarat 364240
- Capacity: 100 KL liquid and 2,500 tonnes solid per month. No minimum order quantity. Lead time about one week.
- Approvals: Gujarat Directorate of Agriculture NOC for 36 biostimulant grades (Schedule VI) and 11 biofertiliser types (Schedule III), Fertiliser (Inorganic, Organic or Mixed) (Control) Order 1985.
- Export: FOB or CIF from Pipavav, Kandla, Dahej, Mundra, JNPT. Markets: GCC, Africa, Russian Federation, Europe, North America, South America. Free samples; buyer pays freight, duty and other charges.
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 99787 91167, sales@gujaratbio.com

## Products
- [Organic fertilizers](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/organic-fertilizer-manufacturer-india): Organic and bio-organic inputs for soil and crop health.
- [Biostimulants](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/biostimulants-manufacturer-india): 36 Schedule VI grades: humic, seaweed, amino, botanical, blends.
- [Humic acid and fulvic acid](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/humic-acid-manufacturer-india): 8 grades, granules, powder and liquid, incl. potassium humate.
- [Seaweed extracts](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/seaweed-extract-manufacturer-india): Ascophyllum, Kappaphycus, Sargassum and Spirulina.
- [Amino acids and protein hydrolysates](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/amino-acid-protein-hydrolysate-manufacturer-india): Plant and animal source, 9 grades.
- [Biofertilisers](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/biofertilisers-manufacturer-india): 11 types: N fixers, PSB, KMB, ZSB, mycorrhizae, consortia.
- [Micronutrients](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/micronutrient-fertilizer-manufacturer-india): Zinc, boron, iron and more, chelated and mixtures, made to order.
- [Special grade fertilizers](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/water-soluble-fertilizer-special-grades): Water-soluble NPK and fortified grades, made to order.
- [Slow-release fertilizers](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/slow-release-fertilizer): Granules that feed over weeks, made to order.
- [Zyme granules](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/zyme-granules-manufacturer): Humic, seaweed and protein granules from listed grades.
- [Custom blends](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/custom-fertilizer-blends): Formulated by our R&D team for your crop and market.
- [Crop-specific products](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/crop-specific-fertilizers): The Immunity range for sugarcane, potato, mango, apple, banana.

## Guides
- [FCO Schedule VI biostimulants](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/fco-schedule-vi-biostimulants): how India regulates biostimulants
- [What is a biostimulant? Meaning, types and uses](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/what-is-a-biostimulant): A plain explanation of biostimulants: what they are, the main types, how they differ from fertilizers, and how they are regulated in India.
- [Biostimulant vs fertilizer vs biofertilizer: the difference](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/biostimulant-vs-fertilizer-vs-biofertilizer): How biostimulants, fertilizers, biofertilizers and plant growth regulators differ, with examples and how to combine them.
- [Humic acid vs fulvic acid: differences, uses and which to choose](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/humic-acid-vs-fulvic-acid): How humic and fulvic acids differ in molecule size, solubility and use, and when to choose each for soil, drip or foliar application.
- [Humic acid uses in agriculture: what it does and how to apply it](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/humic-acid-uses-in-agriculture): What humic acid does for soil and crops, which form to use when, how it is applied by crop, and common mistakes to avoid.
- [Potassium humate vs humic acid: what is the difference?](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/potassium-humate-vs-humic-acid): Potassium humate is soluble humic acid. Here is how the two differ, what grades like 49% and 98% mean, and which to use.
- [Seaweed extract uses in agriculture: benefits and how to apply](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/seaweed-extract-uses-in-agriculture): What seaweed extract does for crops, liquid vs granules, when to apply, and what to check when buying.
- [Kappaphycus vs Ascophyllum vs Sargassum: which seaweed extract?](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/kappaphycus-vs-ascophyllum-vs-sargassum): How the three main seaweeds used in biostimulants differ, what grades like Kappaphycus alvarezii 24 (liquid) mean, and how to choose.
- [Protein hydrolysate vs amino acid fertilizer: the difference](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/protein-hydrolysate-vs-amino-acid): How protein hydrolysates and amino acid fertilizers differ, plant vs animal source, and how they are used.
- [What are zyme granules? Composition, uses and what to check](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/what-are-zyme-granules): Zyme granules explained: what they contain, how farmers use them, and what distributors should check after the 2025 biostimulant rules.
- [Slow-release vs water-soluble fertilizer: which to use when](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/slow-release-vs-water-soluble-fertilizer): How slow-release and water-soluble fertilizers differ, where each fits in a crop programme, and how to combine them.
- [Can humic acid be mixed with fertilizers and pesticides?](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/can-humic-acid-be-mixed-with-fertilizers-and-pesticides): A practical compatibility guide for humic acid, seaweed and amino acids with NPK, urea, micronutrients, calcium, fungicides and biofertilisers, with a jar test method.
- [How to start your own fertilizer brand with private label](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/how-to-start-a-fertilizer-brand-private-label): A step-by-step guide to launching an organic fertilizer or biostimulant brand without building a factory: products, compliance, packaging and costs.
- [How to import biostimulants and fertilizers from India](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/how-to-import-biostimulants-from-india): A practical guide for importers: sampling, registration, quotes and Incoterms, documents and shipping from Indian ports.
- [Types of biofertilizers: names, examples and uses](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/types-of-biofertilizers): A list of biofertilizer types, Azotobacter, Rhizobium, Azospirillum, Acetobacter, PSB, KMB, ZSB and mycorrhizae, with what each does and how to apply them.
- [Micronutrient deficiency symptoms in crops: a field guide](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/micronutrient-deficiency-symptoms-in-crops): How to recognise zinc, boron, iron, manganese, copper and molybdenum deficiency in crops, and what growers do about it.
- [Choosing a biostimulant manufacturer: a buyer's checklist](https://b2b.gujaratbio.com/resources/choosing-a-biostimulant-manufacturer-checklist): Twelve questions distributors, brands and importers should ask before choosing a biostimulant or organic fertilizer manufacturer.
